'''Omar 2''' was a [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] located at [[Omar]]. It was owned by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It was used to produce [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]].

Omar 2 was attacked by rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Attack on Omar|First Battle of Omar]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces loyal to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] managed to evacuate the facility during the attack. An additional group of survivors, who were accidentally left behind on the station, fled the scene on the transport [[Runner (starship)|''Runner'']]. The facility was later destroyed.
